thread:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up - hiring dashboard showing a surge of 'archived' scorecards from yesterday's panel. Several interviewers say they submitted scores but the rows are locked. Anyone know what changed?
Aly (Recruiter): I just had a candidate where two interviewers' scores disappeared. They swore they filled them in after the interview.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Checking the archive service logs now. There was a deploy last night that adjusted the auto-archive window from 72h -> 48h and also switched cron to UTC without accounting for local calendar event times.
archive-bot: :warning: auto-archive job "scorecard-ttl" ran at 2026-03-23T02:15:00Z and archived 134 scorecards. Reason: ttl_exceeded.
Noah (Hiring Manager): That explains why interviews scheduled late PST yesterday got archived before interviewers even woke up. We need those restored for today's debrief.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Log excerpt: ```[2026-03-23T02:15:03Z] INFO archive: candidate_id=12983 scorecard_id=4432 status=archived ttl=48h cron_tz=UTC```
Aly (Recruiter): Is there a quick way to un-archive the recent ones and reopen editing? We have 6 affected candidates in the backend loop.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): I can run an emergency revert to the previous mapping and reopen scorecards archived within the last 72h by checking linked calendar events and submission timestamps. Doing a dry-run now.
archive-bot: :information_source: dry-run complete. 22 scorecards match reopen criteria (archived < 24h, interview_time between 2026-03-22T20:00-23:59 PST).
Maya (People Ops): Please reopen those 22 and notify the interviewers. Also we should pause auto-archive while you investigate.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Paused job and queued a reopen job (id: reopen-2026-03-23-07). Reopen will set status=editable and send notification to assigned interviewers.
Aly (Recruiter): Thanks. I'll message the interviewers and ask them to re-submit any missing scores before the debrief at 11am PT.
Noah (Hiring Manager): If we can't get scores in time, we'll reschedule the debrief. Can't calibrate on incomplete data.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Root cause summary: deploy inadvertently shortened TTL and changed cron TZ. Hotfix plan: 1) revert TTL to 72h, 2) add calendar-aware exclusion (don't archive if interview_time + 24h > now), 3) add an audit alert when archived count for rolling 24h spikes >5%.
Maya (People Ops): Also add a playbook note: when changing TTL/cron, run a staging simulation against calendar data and alert recruiters.
archive-bot: :rocket: hotfix PR opened: https://go.redwood/pr/2098 (revert ttl + exclude recent calendar events). CI checks running.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Deploying hotfix to staging now. Will run a targeted reopen for the 22 and post once done.
Aly (Recruiter): Quick ask: can we add a little UI nudge in GH reminding interviewers to submit scores within 24h and a link to quick-reenter if reopened? That reduces friction.
Maya (People Ops): Yes, add that to the interviewer training refresher and I'll update the quick-ref doc. Also adding a requirement for any infra changes affecting ATS to be communicated 24h prior to production deploy.
Theo (Recruiting Ops): Reopen job complete. 22 scorecards reopened, notifications sent. archive-bot: :white_check_mark: reopen job succeeded.
Noah (Hiring Manager): Got the notices. Interviewers are re-submitting now. Thanks for the fast response.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: Theo - merge hotfix and deploy, add archive spike alert; Aly - message interviewers and update GH nudge UX request; Maya - update training doc & change communication rule; Theo/Aly - follow up if any reopened scorecards still missing after 11am PT.
archive-bot: :bell: monitoring rule created: "archive-spike-24h" threshold=5% notify=#people-ops.
